title: Upgrade to v1.25.0 (Consensus determinism hardening: fail-fast on params/profile decode failures, on-chain recent-block-hashes window for PoW)
summary: Replaces the previous never-halt invariant with a fail-fast contract for consensus-critical decode paths. core.GetParams now panics with CONSENSUS_FATAL on store-get / empty / unmarshal / validate failure instead of silently substituting DefaultParams (the original mirage.talk divergence vector at height 4,349,996). deductRelayGasFee, processSubscriptions, and the PoW ante (getUserLevel / checkReserveOrDowngrade) now return tagged CONSENSUS_FATAL errors on profile decode/missing failures rather than silently routing through the wrong code branch. Adds an on-chain rolling window of recently-committed block hashes (new state key recent_block_hashes, written each BeginBlock from ctx.BlockHeader().LastBlockId.Hash, length bounded by params.BlockHashWindow) and replaces the per-process in-memory PoW recent-hash cache with reads from this window — eliminating restart-vs-warm-node divergence. EndBlock now propagates iterator failures from GetExpiredSubscriptions instead of silently skipping renewals. No new chain params; no genesis migration. Brief UX dip: the on-chain window starts empty at the upgrade height and refills over BlockHashWindow blocks; PoW envelopes referencing pre-upgrade block hashes will be rejected for that period and clients will automatically retry with the new last_block_hash.
